description: Source code for the PrettyDiff command class, which generates and displays a pretty diff in a web browser, including methods for executing the diff, handling errors, and opening the diff in a viewer.

classes.name: PrettyDiff
classes.description: A command class that shows a pretty diff in the default browser, with methods for executing the diff, handling errors, and opening the diff file.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PrettyDiff command with specific options.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the pretty diff command, prompts user confirmation, and handles exit if diff is incorrect.

methods.name: _show_pretty_diff
methods.description: Generates the pretty diff file and opens it in the browser, handling errors.

methods.name: _diff
methods.description: Creates a patch from the changed files based on the provided options.

methods.name: _open_pretty_diff
methods.description: Opens the generated diff file in the default browser or via cygstart on Cygwin.
